nativeBehavior.feedback: Native RippleDrawable tinted by outline, zero button elevation and no state animator; browser previews approximate active/focus only.
nativeBehavior.typography: No fixed line-height or custom font asset. Action weight inherits native Button. Selected nav is bold; bottom labels are 11sp.
nativeBehavior.dataSemantics: Download uses primary/periwinkle; upload uses legacy diagnostic_download/teal. Connection totals remain ink. Missing is em dash, never fabricated zero.
nativeBehavior.secureWorkspaces: FLAG_SECURE, private storage, masking, asynchronous workers, per-profile drafts, confirmation and no replay remain intact.
nativeBehavior.logSnapshot: Pause retains snapshot; read failure retains content; follow tail only when at bottom; filter resets to top. Export reads all retained logs.
nativeBehavior.sourceSelection: Primary color at 20% alpha (0x33), native text selection and cursor behavior.
nativeBehavior.assetProvenance: ic_squirrelboard.xml faithfully copies local ../squirrelboard/public/favicon.svg geometry as native vector. Other interface icons are native vector XML; no shipping raster.
nativeBehavior.connectionDisclosure: Initially collapsed help expands inline before TCP/UDP metrics and toggles info/close icons, action names, tooltips and expanded/collapsed state on supported Android versions. Disclosure state survives supported recreation; every metric widget remains in the scrollable layout.
nativeBehavior.connectionMetrics: Shared Download/Upload totals panel; Runtime TCP/UDP session counts and upload/download totals, followed by Tasks, Resident and Allocated rows. Normal refresh explanation is omitted; pending, incomplete and failed metric notices remain inline.
nativeBehavior.diagnosticListHeaders: Sessions and Proxies use icon/count headings and search-icon filters. Matched / total appears when filtered; pending data is a dash. Full count/live semantics remain accessible and in tooltips. Compact title/count blocks sit beside filter controls; no repeated subtitle or separate live-summary row.
nativeBehavior.sessionMeasurements: Selectable destination and full protocol/route remain. Upload/download arrows accompany totals; lightning first-response and clock duration share a second row. Full measurement names remain accessible and in tooltips. Half closed retains an explicit label and half-circle icon. No metrics require expansion.
nativeBehavior.proxyControls: Selector headers show checked selected-member text plus outbound-icon member counts. Refresh icons trigger existing HTTP probes; cached probe latency retains lightning. Pending probes and selector actions use disabled hourglasses, preserving the last confirmed selection and all transport measurements.
nativeBehavior.yamlPanel: Edit YAML opens a native Dialog over the scrollable controls page. Save validates asynchronously and remains open. Close and native Back retain the draft; outside taps do not dismiss. Successful import, download and template loading open it for review. Both windows retain FLAG_SECURE. Activity recreation restores open state, selection, scroll, focus and IME visibility with retained per-profile drafts; no new process-death persistence or autosave.
nativeBehavior.yamlPanelShortViewport: Measured inner height below 300dp hides profile/status context; title, Save, Close and source remain. Initial open does not force the IME; restored focus/IME follows saved state.

extensions.rampPolicy: Eight-step OKLCH ramps are synthesized for panel visualization only. Actual native colors are exclusively the DESIGN.md frontmatter/day-night resources; ramp steps are not shipping tokens.
extensions.notCanonized: Pre-existing Selection chip preview and route-chip tokens differ from the current circular selector controls; retained outside this YAML-panel scope, not promoted as guidance for the new component.

narrative.overview:
Squirrelboard’s precise dashboard language expressed through native Android Views. A cool gray canvas supports white outlined panels, slate text, periwinkle selection and teal transfer accents. Charcoal day/night counterparts preserve the same hierarchy. The local reference is `../squirrelboard`; the native implementation owns the values recorded here, including stronger light-mode text accents for contrast.

The same materials cover Connection, Proxies, Configuration, Logs, Sessions, API tools and app-owned dialogs. Technical detail remains visible through labeled measurements, native text scaling and large source panes. The header displays the Squirrel wordmark without an adjacent icon; the reference vector asset remains available. Android system sans replaces the reference’s web font, while YAML, logs and protocol/JSON results use native monospace.
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray canvas, white or charcoal panels and thin outlines.
Periwinkle selection and download roles; teal upload and green local-engine status.
Small rounded actions, larger panel corners and flat native ripple feedback.
System sans, tabular measurements and monospace source data.
Adaptive bottom navigation, horizontal tabs and an expanded navigation rail.

rules.name: The Labeled Direction Rule
rules.body: Use periwinkle for download and teal for upload. Connection columns show Download then Upload; session pairs put upload before download. Session and proxy measurements use upload/download vector arrows with full accessible labels and tooltips. Direction remains identifiable independently of color.

rules.name: The Figures Stay Put Rule
rules.body: Use tabular figures for changing measurements and preserve identity and alignment during refresh.

rules.name: The Outlined Panel Rule
rules.body: Separate work areas with panel fill and a thin outline; keep ordinary panels and actions flat.

dos: **Do** use the matched day/night resource roles across all five destinations, API tools and app-owned dialogs.
**Do** retain direction labels, tabular numbers and explicit unavailable, empty, error and busy states.
**Do** use native sp scaling, dp geometry and at least 48dp for action and filter touch targets.
**Do** keep Connection’s primary action before wrapping detail/profile text in short viewports.
**Do** preserve long identifiers, filter state, editor drafts, secure-window behavior and live reading position.
**Do** distinguish local-engine state from remote reachability, saved configuration from drafts and visible log filtering from full retained-log export.
donts: **Don’t** restore violet chrome, lavender-filled workspaces or capsule actions from the superseded Technical atlas.
**Don’t** shrink native controls to the reference website’s compact desktop dimensions.
**Don’t** invent chart data, traffic history, remote connectivity claims or production fixture labels.
**Don’t** apply the YAML focus border to every native field or replace native errors, selection and keyboard behavior.
**Don’t** add shadows or web hover motion to ordinary native panels and buttons.
